Chapter by chapter

How we became us

Chapter 1

The Hello

Two strangers, one ordinary day, and a hello that quietly changed everything. I did not know it then, but my life had just found its favourite person.

Chapter 2

Long talks, short nights

Conversations that never wanted to end. Your laugh became my favourite sound and every goodnight became harder to say.

Chapter 3

Becoming each other's home

Through festivals, sarees, silly photos and quiet days, I learned that home is not a place. It is you.

Chapter 4

Today

I have loved you in every season so far. Now I want to love you for every season that is left. Scroll down, Padmini. There is something I want to ask you.
